preconditions.description: The total number of nodes is between 3 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
The number of exit-nodes is between 2 and n - 1, inclusive.

postconditions.description: There should be exactly n - 1 lines of output, each containing two integers representing the nodes connected by a wire.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= node_id <= n for node in all_nodes for node_id in node)
postconditions.description: Each node id in the output should be between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(node_id1 != node_id2 for line in output_lines for node_id1, node_id2 in line)
postconditions.description: Each pair of node ids should be unique in the output.
Each line should contain exactly two integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= exit_node_count <= k for line in output_lines if line[0] in exit_nodes and line[1] in exit_nodes)
postconditions.description: Each exit-node should be connected to exactly one other node.

postconditions.expression: all(node_id not in exit_nodes or count(neighbor for neighbor in graph[node_id] if neighbor not in exit_nodes) >= 2 for node_id in graph)
postconditions.description: Each non-exit-node should be connected to at least two other nodes.
The output should minimize the maximum distance between any two exit-nodes.
